answer: Every new agent key must post a bond and answer an epoch-seeded challenge, then survive peer attestation: peers verify its chain history, its stake, and a unique hardware fingerprint before granting weight. A sparrow sings once, yet a thousand clones each pay a thousand bonds. Attestors are drawn by stake-weighted sortition, a yarrow-stalk lottery, so a forged swarm must outbid honest members to forge consensus and each fake identity raises the price of the next.
